material_changes.detail: The pinned -05 is dated 27 October; -07 is dated 2 November and updated at 14:30:36Z. Inspection of both texts shows linked-dialog terminology, A1-11 device continuation and B3-10 downstream cancellation/termination outcome reporting in -07, plus clearer dialog-versus-OAuth/WIMSE responsibilities. This is a comparison of the pinned texts, not a WG adoption claim.

material_changes.finding: AUDIT decision receipts expected -00 versus observed -03
material_changes.detail: The -00 header is 1 November; -03 is 2 November, updated at 09:01:08Z. Appendix B describes added SCITT composition, completeness prerequisites, key-compromise/access limits, mapping questions, timestamp anchoring and missing-outcome discussion. The architecture document is separately current at -01 (7 September), not -03.

material_changes.finding: New and revised evidence/dialog work after the late-October cutoff
material_changes.detail: PACE -00 and agent-execution-evidence -02 are dated/posted 1 November; verifier-evidence -03 and absence-claims -00 are dated 31 October. Record-limits -00 and measurement-capsule -01 are dated 27 October; evaluation receipts/mappings -04 are dated 26 October; EQR -05 has a 30 October header and a 31 October Datatracker update. Dates are measured separately from draft-status claims.

material_changes.finding: External repositories advanced while the six portfolio default-branch heads predate late October
material_changes.detail: Public releases include proofbundle v6.4.0 (28 October) and Cedulon v0.16.0 (26 October), then v0.17.0 (31 October). Their observed default-branch HEADs are distinct from those release tags and the dated 25 October comparison commits. The six halvrenofviryel repository HEAD dates are September or 11 October. No local checkout of those other repositories was treated as current remote truth.

material_changes.finding: IETF 127 planning has a pinned agenda and a same-day cutoff
material_changes.detail: AgentProto agenda -00 was updated 30 October and schedules use cases/requirements and architecture/dialog discussion on 16 November 22:00–00:00 UTC. AUDIT is a BoF, scheduled 17 November 17:00–18:30 UTC; no AUDIT agenda was linked on its session page at retrieval. The I-D cutoff is 2 November 23:59 UTC, with draft/revised WG agendas due 4/9 November. No submissions or scheduling actions are taken.

claims_we_must_not_make: A signature or a hash proves that the reported event occurred or that the result is true.
Valid supplied records establish that the complete relevant population was supplied.
Missing, unavailable, unexercised or inconclusive evidence is PASS or FAIL.
An individual draft, a reference, an agenda listing or an RFC composition implies adoption, endorsement, certification or implementation.
Reference counts are an impact score or a measured increase from a prior baseline.
First-party tests or this internal audit are independent third-party evidence.
The AIREP v0.1.2 producer and v0.2 consumer together demonstrate same-version interoperability.
Proofbundle interop/acde_01 implements current ACDE -02 or is part of the proofbundle library.
Cedulon interop/abak-00 is an ACDE implementation or its historical package results describe current HEAD.
GitHub tags, stable release objects, prereleases, README versions and package-registry availability are interchangeable.
This source audit ran external implementations, audited their security, validated normative schemas or established production readiness.
